# Paths that are not production logging call sites.
# The checker does not flag these. Each entry is a rule: <kind>:<value>
#
# kind:
#   prefix          path equals the value or is under that directory
#   exact           path equals the value
#   suffix          file name ends with the value
#   segment         a directory in the path equals the value
#   path-contains   the relative path contains the value
#
# Generated files are also skipped when the first 40 lines contain both
# "Code generated" and "DO NOT EDIT".

# Logger implementation. It is the supported backend logging API.
prefix:pkg/infra/log/

# Vendored Google Wire CLI, including fixture programs that print by design.
prefix:pkg/build/wire/

# Copied libraries. They are not Grafana application logging.
prefix:pkg/util/xorm/
prefix:pkg/components/simplejson/

# Test helpers and integration harnesses that are not *_test.go files.
prefix:pkg/tests/
prefix:pkg/mocks/
prefix:pkg/util/testutil/

# Live pipeline poster marked temporary for development.
exact:pkg/services/live/pipeline/devdata.go

# Go tests, generated stubs, and testdata fixtures.
suffix:_test.go
suffix:.gen.go
suffix:_gen.go
suffix:.pb.go
suffix:wire_gen.go
path-contains:/testdata/

# Frontend tests, stories, and generated files.
suffix:.test.ts
suffix:.test.tsx
suffix:.test.js
suffix:.test.jsx
suffix:.spec.ts
suffix:.spec.tsx
suffix:.spec.js
suffix:.spec.jsx
suffix:.story.ts
suffix:.story.tsx
suffix:.stories.ts
suffix:.stories.tsx
suffix:.mock.ts
suffix:.mock.tsx
suffix:.gen.ts
suffix:_gen.ts

# Test and fixture directories inside public/app and pkg.
segment:__mocks__
segment:__tests__
segment:mocks
segment:fixtures
segment:test
segment:tests
segment:testing
